12
Which statement describes activation energy?
A
It is the maximum energy given out during a reaction.
B
It is the maximum energy taken in during a reaction.
C
It is the minimum energy colliding particles must have to react.
D
It is the minimum energy particles must have to make bonds.
subject: Chemistry

options.label: A
options.html: It is the maximum energy given out during a reaction.

options.label: B
